headline: Colombian Joint Economic Commissions Approve 2026 Budget Addition
summary: Colombia's Joint Economic Commissions approved a 2026 budget addition in its first debate, reallocating funds for reconstruction and energy without increasing net debt.
why: Legislative budget adjustments dictate government spending priorities and fiscal management without altering sovereign debt issuance levels.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Fiscal reallocations impact public sector spending allocation for energy and reconstruction.
